statement: You are given two strings s and t.
t is an anagram of s when it uses exactly the same letters as s, each the same number of times, possibly in a different order.
Return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise.

examples.explanation: Both strings have three a's and one each of g, m, n and r.
t has a c where s has a t, so the letter counts differ.

constraints: s and t consist of lowercase English letters
